## Constraints

### Must

- Label fictional sample products and AI concept imagery clearly.
- Preserve accessible native dialogs, keyboard controls and server-backed commerce.

### Avoid

- Gradients, heavy gold, marketplace styling and unverified brand heritage claims.

## Decisions

- Original ORVEN identity; split campaign hero, considered collection photography,
  warm neutrals and a calm, precise voice. Project-native React components were
  created because 21st catalog search required an unavailable authentication token.

- Administration is a separate operations workspace: espresso sidebar, compact
  Manrope headings, warm neutral surfaces, restrained status colours, practical
  dashboard and structured editors. Records are filtered and paginated on the
  server with shareable URL state. This density applies to admin routes only.
